subject: Demo request — HealthLoop: workflow automation / patient intake
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan@healthloop.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Demo request — HealthLoop: workflow automation / patient intake

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for a demo through the site and wanted to follow up directly. We're HealthLoop, a digital health startup focused on automating patient intake and care coordination for mid-size clinics. High level: we want to explore using Redwood to power conversational triage and form completion so we can reduce manual intake work.

Quick details:
- Use case: patient intake + follow-up messaging, templated clinical summaries
- Expected monthly volume: ~3M tokens initially, ramping to ~10M over 6 months
- Timeline: pilot within 4–6 weeks, production by Q3

Curious about model options for PHI-handling, deployment (we may need VPC), and rough pricing for the volumes above. Would love to set up a 30 min demo next week to see the product and ask technical questions. Our CTO (Aisha) would join if possible.

Thanks,
Jordan Myers
Head of Product, HealthLoop
jordan@healthloop.com
(415) 555-0127

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@healthloop.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — HealthLoop: workflow automation / patient intake

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to get a demo scheduled. A few quick qualification questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Is the 3M -> 10M token estimate monthly for generation tokens only (responses) or does that include embeddings/recall tokens?
2) Do you need guaranteed data residency / VPC from day one or is that a production requirement only?
3) Any strict latency SLOs (e.g., 200ms p95 for short prompts)?
4) Who is the decision owner and timeline for contract/PO?

I have availability next week (PST) on Tue 3/3 10:00–11:30, Wed 3/4 14:00–16:00, or Thu 3/5 09:00–12:00. You can also pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-demo/30min?event=abc123

I’ll include Rishi (AE) on the call for pricing and deployment questions. Attached a short one-pager with key product notes to help prep.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Inbound SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]

From: Jordan Myers <jordan@healthloop.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — HealthLoop: workflow automation / patient intake

Thanks Marissa — answers below.

1) The 3M/10M are primarily generation tokens (responses & templates). We do use embeddings for search but that’s comparatively small (~200k vectors/month).
2) VPC/data residency: would like VPC for production; pilot can run hosted.
3) Latency: target ~500ms p95 is fine for most flows; we have a few internal paths that would want <250ms but not across the whole workload.
4) Decision owner: CTO Aisha Rahman + Head of Engineering; procurement timeline: aiming to have vendor decision by end of March.

Wed 3/4 14:00 PST works for us. Aisha (aisha@healthloop.com) will join — please invite her. If you need any API keys or example payloads ahead of time, tell me and I’ll get them over.

—Jordan
